messages:
elaine: Quick flag: ran a short AB on reranker-v2 (PTQ int8) comparing a 'short-priming' prefix vs raw queries. Mixed signals across corpora.

ryan: numbers?

elaine: small snapshot (holdout 2026-03-10, n=3k):
```
corpus | arm    | ndcg@10 | mrr
webfaq | base   | 0.705   | 0.455
webfaq | primed | 0.718   | 0.450
support| base   | 0.660   | 0.395
support| primed | 0.648   | 0.381
```

elaine: Observed tokenization diffs on short queries where priming introduced extra subword splits; top-k score margins shrink and ties flip. HTML-heavy docs make it worse.

ryan: hypothesis: priming changes token boundaries -> PTQ quant noise amplifies small margins -> MRR drops. NDCG helps for ambiguous webfaq queries.

elaine: proposed next steps:
- run paired eval with --strip-html
- rerun PTQ calibrate with two different seeds
- emit per-query token diffs and delta histograms
- try punctuation-safe prefix ("Query:\n") to avoid merges

eval-bot: Job 6299999999-1 queued: eval_rerank (primed vs base, samples=3000).

ryan: 👍 also add deterministic tie-breaker by doc_id for measurement only, not rollout.

elaine: will push artifacts to s3 and post results when done.
